description: Select all clips in the active sequence that match a name (substring match). Optionally filter by track type and index.

add_to_selection.description: If true, add to existing selection instead of replacing it (default: false)

name.description: Clip name to search for (case-insensitive substring match)

track_index.description: Specific track index to search (optional, searches all if omitted)

name: select_clips_by_name

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Select Clips By Name
